site_name: London Museum Of Water And Steam
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - Details are to be provided for approval of the proposed infill material for the gutters and falls/ relationship to downpipes.

Condition : 4 - Detailed drawings are to be provided for approval showing a large scale section showing the profile and box details of the existing sash windows.   (If "horns"  exist they should be indicated, otherwise the proposed sash windows should not have horns).
Condition : 5 - Detailed drawings are to be provided for approval indicating the roof repairs schedule and details of the repairs, location, method and materials to be used.
description: Installation of new windows, re-lining of parapet gutters and roof repairs to existing building.
